archetypes.name: dyn-reviewer-status-artifacts
archetypes.rationale: Reviewer status artifacts now span per-round and stable paths with symlink and stale-state handling.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the Python reviewer-status table artifact lifecycle. Check that render failures, header-only TSVs, symlinked destinations, and latest TSV copy failures cannot leave stale stable reviewer table content. Verify explicit round numbers win on hot paths and env binding is only a post-envelope fallback. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-design-table-contract
archetypes.rationale: The design skill now relies on a pre-rendered table file instead of prompt-side TSV rendering.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 3 SKILL.md compact-table contract against the Python artifacts. Confirm all three prompt-side sites tell the orchestrator to Read the stable table, emit it verbatim, warn with the exact missing-table literal, and parse the loop env only afterward. Look for leftover prose that could resurrect manual TSV rendering. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
